berichten.samenvatting_orig: © Meatly Das britische Unternehmen Meatly, das kultiviertes Fleisch für Heimtiernahrung herstellt, ist nach Grapht Works umgezogen. berichten.titel: Nutritional and bioactive diversity of mangrove fruits: a comparative perspective for functional food development
berichten.samenvatting: Mangrove fruits are emerging as a promising functional food ingredient due to their rich nutritional composition and diverse phytochemical content, including phenolics, flavonoids, and other bioactive compounds. These components contribute to a wide range of health-promoting effects, such as antioxidant, antidiabetic, and antimicrobial activities. Despite their potential, mangrove fruits remain underutilized in many parts of the world.
berichten.kernzin: Een studie beschrijft de voedingswaarde en bioactieve stoffen van mangrovevruchten als functioneel voedsel.

berichten.titel: Food literacy competencies and diet quality in youth adhering to vegan, lacto-ovo-vegetarian, pescatarian or omnivorous diets in Sweden
berichten.samenvatting: To assess food literacy competencies and diet quality in youth adhering to vegan, lacto-ovo-vegetarian, pescatarian or omnivorous diets in Sweden and to investigate if, and which, food literacy competencies are associated with youths' diet quality. Cross-sectional study. Food literacy competencies (general nutrition knowledge (GNK), critical nutrition literacy (CNL) and food skills) were measured using a web-based questionnaire. A Diet Quality Index (DQI) score was calculated using usual intake data and based on alignment with the Nordic Nutrition Recommendations 2023 (NNR2023).
berichten.kernzin: Een Zweedse studie vergelijkt voedselgeletterdheid en dieetkwaliteit bij jongeren met veganistische, lacto-ovo-vegetarische, pescetarische of alleseter-diëten.

berichten.titel: How Plants Feed Our Microbes: Plant-Based Diets and Gut Microbiota Modulation-A Systematic Review
berichten.samenvatting: Diet is a key factor shaping gut microbiota composition and function, with important implications for human health. The growing popularity of plant-based dietary patterns has increased interest in their effects on the gut microbiota. This systematic review examines specific changes in gut microbiota among individuals following a plant-based diet (PBD), as well as shifts occurring after transitioning from an omnivorous diet.
berichten.kernzin: Een systematische review onderzoekt hoe plantaardige diëten de darmmicrobiota beïnvloeden.

berichten.titel: Microbial biosynthesis of fatty acids for human health: biological evidence, production advances, and commercial challenges
berichten.samenvatting: Several fatty acid (FA) families with established, debated, or emerging health relevance-including long-chain n-3 (EPA, DHA), n-6 (GLA, ARA), branched-chain FA (BCFA), and odd-chain FA (OCFA)-remain scarce in conventional diets, largely absent from plant-based diets, or face supply vulnerabilities driven by climate change and declining marine resources. Bridging the gap between nutritional demand and sustainable supply requires both a clearer understanding of these FA physiological roles and the development of alternative production systems.
berichten.kernzin: Een wetenschappelijk overzicht bespreekt microbiële productie van vetzuren die in plantaardige diëten schaars zijn.

berichten.titel: Impacts of a low fat whole food plant-based diet on vitamin and mineral intake in advanced CKD populations, a secondary analysis of a randomized control trial
berichten.samenvatting: Low fat whole-food plant-based (LFWFPB) dietary patterns are increasingly recommended for patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) because of potential cardiometabolic benefits. However, the micronutrient effects of adopting a LFWFPB diet in patients with moderate to advanced CKD remain incompletely characterized. We conducted a secondary analysis of a randomized pilot trial involving adults with CKD stages 3 to 4 assigned to a 15-day LFWFPB nutrition education program or usual care.
berichten.kernzin: Een secundaire analyse onderzoekt de effecten van een vetarm plantaardig dieet op vitamine- en mineraalinname bij mensen met chronische nierziekte.
berichten.uitgever: Journal of renal nutrition : the official journal of the Council on Renal Nutrition of the National Kidney Foundation

berichten.titel: Effects of vegetarian or vegan diets on cardiovascular metabolic health in patients with cardiovascular disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
berichten.samenvatting: Vegetarian or vegan diets have been associated with favorable cardiovascular outcomes in the general population; however, their effects on cardiometabolic risk factors in patients with established cardiovascular disease (CVD) remain unclear. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the effects of vegetarian or vegan dietary interventions on cardiometabolic risk factors in patients with CVD. A systematic search of five electronic databases was conducted from inception to January 1, 2026.
berichten.kernzin: Een systematische review en meta-analyse onderzoekt de effecten van vegetarische of veganistische diëten op cardiometabole gezondheid bij patiënten met hart- en vaatziekten.

berichten.titel: Vitamin B12 Biofortification of Plant-Based Foods Through Fermentation With Propionibacterium freudenreichii: Mechanisms, Challenges, and Opportunities
berichten.samenvatting: Vitamin B12 (VB12) is essential for human health but occurs predominantly in animal-derived foods, posing a challenge for adequate intake on plant-based diets. Fermentation with Propionibacterium freudenreichii offers a route to in situ fortification, in which the vitamin is generated within the food matrix rather than added as a purified fortificant, eliminating the separation and purification steps required for industrial production. This review examines the mechanistic and technological basis of that approach.
berichten.kernzin: Een overzichtsstudie bekijkt hoe plantaardige voeding via fermentatie met Propionibacterium freudenreichii verrijkt kan worden met vitamine B12.
berichten.uitgever: Comprehensive reviews in food science and food safety

berichten.titel: Perceptions and Attitudes Toward Plant-Based Meat Alternatives: A Systematic Meta-Ethnography Review
berichten.samenvatting: Plant-based meat alternatives (PBMAs) can support the transition toward healthier and more sustainable dietary patterns. However, PBMA adoption remains limited despite availability and awareness of health and environmental benefits, highlighting a gap between potential and practice. This review sought to synthesize evidence on perceptions and attitudes toward PBMAs across populations and to examine how sociodemographic factors shape consumer perspectives. A comprehensive search was conducted across MEDLINE, CINAHL, Web of Science, Greenfile, and Cochrane from inception to August 2025.
berichten.kernzin: Een systematische meta-ethnografische review analyseert percepties en houdingen ten opzichte van plantaardige vleesvervangers.

berichten.titel: Prevalence and Risk Factors of Vitamin B12 Deficiency in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Patients on Metformin at a Tertiary Care Center of Nepal
berichten.samenvatting: Background Vitamin B12 deficiency is a common but often underrecognized complication in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) undergoing long-term metformin therapy. If undetected, it may lead to serious complications including neuropathy, cognitive decline and anemia. Objective To determine the prevalence and risk factors of vitamin B12 deficiency in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) patients on metformin at a tertiary care center in Nepal. Method An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted among 318 patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) receiving metformin therapy.
berichten.kernzin: Studie in Nepal onderzoekt de prevalentie van vitamine B12-tekort bij type 2-diabetespatiënten die metformine gebruiken.

berichten.samenvatting: The purpose of this study was to evaluate the association of metabolomic signatures reflecting adherence and metabolic response to dietary patterns with prevalence and structural severity of age-related macular degeneration (AMD). berichten.titel: Phenethyl alcohol-assisted high-pressure homogenization enhances EPA preservation and facilitates lipid release from Nannochloropsis oceanica biomass during in vitro digestion
berichten.samenvatting: Microalgal biomass is a sustainable and vegan source of polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), but the rigid cell wall of Nannochloropsis sp. limits lipid release and its effective utilization in food and feed applications. This study investigated the effects of high-pressure homogenization (HPH), alone and in combination with phenethyl alcohol (PEA), a food-grade membrane-permeabilizing agent, on the disruption of Nannochloropsis oceanica cells.
berichten.kernzin: Een onderzoek toont dat hogedrukhomogenisatie met phenethylalcohol lipiden vrijmaakt uit Nannochloropsis-microalgen.

berichten.titel: Beyond protein quantity: in vitro assessments of sex- and age-related differences in the digestibility of animal- and plant-based proteins
berichten.samenvatting: The shift toward sustainable plant-based diets calls for protein-quality assessments of processed foods that account for consumer-oriented differences in digestion. This study evaluated in vitro protein digestibility and Digestible Indispensable Amino Acid Ratios (DIAAR) of six animal- and plant-based protein sources across three digestively distinct physiologies: adult male (consensus benchmark), adult female (capturing sex-specific gastric pH and bile profiles), and senior (70+ years, addressing age-related digestive decline).
berichten.kernzin: Een studie vergelijkt in vitro de verteerbaarheid van dier- en plantaardige eiwitten bij mannen, vrouwen en senioren.

Recommendations for well-balanced vegan diets are available, but the risk of nutrient deficiencies among strict vegans is of particular concern, especially among children and pregnant or breast-feeding women.ObjectivesThe aim of this study was to compare food and nutrition literacy, knowledge of selected potentially critical nutrients, and sources of nutritional information between a convenience sample of Austrian vegan women of reproductive age and a quota-based sample of non-vegan Austrian…

berichten.titel: Effects of eating behavior patterns and dietary habits on the therapeutic efficacy of Parkinson's disease medications: from phenomena, mechanisms to clinical applications
berichten.samenvatting: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a common progressive neurodegenerative disorder managed primarily through pharmacological dopamine replacement therapies-including levodopa (L-DOPA), dopamine receptor agonists, MAO-B inhibitors, COMT inhibitors, and novel non-dopaminergic agents like adenosine A2A receptor antagonists. However, long-term pharmacotherapy faces major challenges such as motor fluctuations, levodopa-induced dyskinesias, erratic gastrointestinal absorption, and inter-individual response variability.
berichten.kernzin: Een studie onderzoekt hoe eetgewoonten de werking van medicatie tegen de ziekte van Parkinson beïnvloeden.

berichten.titel: Ember, öt betű en een wereldwijde beweging: zo begon 82 jaar geleden het tijdperk van het veganisme
berichten.samenvatting: Op 1 november wordt de Wereld Veganisme Dag gevierd, al is de datum niet gebaseerd op een precies gedocumenteerde gebeurtenis. De beweging ontstond in 1944 tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog, toen zes Britten besloten een nieuwe naam aan hun levensstijl te geven.
berichten.kernzin: Prove.hu schrijft dat de Wereld Veganisme Dag op 1 november valt en dat het veganisme in 1944 in Engeland begon.
berichten.titel_orig: Hat ember, öt betű és egy világméretű mozgalom – így kezdődött 82 éve a veganizmus korszaka
berichten.samenvatting_orig: November 1-jén tartják a vegán világnapot, de kevesen tudják, hogy az ünnep dátuma nem egy pontosan dokumentált történelmi eseményhez kötődik. A mozgalom története 1944-ben, a második világháború idején kezdődött, amikor hat brit úgy döntött, új nevet ad az életmódjának. A különös szóalkotásból világszerte ismert fogalom lett, amelyhez mára nemcsak etikai kérdések, hanem jelentős tudományos kutatások…

berichten.titel: Cell-cultured pork biomass as an emerging food ingredient: Physicochemical properties and heat-induced structuring under low-salt conditions
berichten.samenvatting: With the rapid development of cellular agriculture, cell-cultured pork biomass (CCPB) has emerged as a promising animal-derived material for next-generation meat products. However, its physicochemical properties, colloidal behavior, and structure-forming mechanisms remain poorly understood, limiting its rational application in food design. This study evaluated the dispersibility, ion-responsive behavior, and heat-induced gelation of CCPB under low-salt conditions, using ovalbumin (OVA), whey protein isolate (WPI), and myofibrillar protein (MP) as reference systems.
berichten.kernzin: Onderzoekers beschrijven de fysisch-chemische eigenschappen van celgekweekt varkensweefsel als nieuw voedingsingrediënt.
